name: Zalameggyes (Hungary)
description: A vertical blue banner with a yellow band at the bottom, charged near the top with a white panel bearing the municipal arms of Zalameggyes (a blue and green shield with cherries and a patriarchal cross) below the name ZALAMEGGYES.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
